hard_failure_rule: Any failed hard check prevents replay.

checks.name: RUNNER_IDENTITY
checks.assertion: runner_id equals pmiri-gc-c1-replay and version is present

checks.name: RUNNER_PACKAGE_INTEGRITY
checks.assertion: runner source/package fingerprint matches declared fingerprint; no self-upgrade

checks.name: MANIFEST_INTEGRITY
checks.assertion: manifest format/version parses and fingerprint is recorded

checks.name: AUTHORITY_BUNDLE_INTEGRITY
checks.assertion: all exact R1/R2/R3 authority refs exist and SHA-256 fingerprints match

checks.name: SCHEMA_INTEGRITY
checks.assertion: Evidence Record schema parses and fingerprint matches

checks.name: FIXTURE_CATALOG_INTEGRITY
checks.assertion: fixture catalog parses and selected fixture fingerprint matches

checks.name: MATRIX_CATALOG_COVERAGE
checks.assertion: selected case maps to R-FC-01..R-FC-17 and positive/adversarial coverage exists

checks.name: CLEAN_ROOM_CAPABILITY
checks.assertion: fresh root, read-only inputs, scoped output, denied home/repository/shared state, teardown available

checks.name: NETWORK_CREDENTIAL_DENIAL
checks.assertion: network/connectors denied and no ambient credentials visible

checks.name: FILESYSTEM_ALLOWLIST
checks.assertion: only declared inputs readable and only scoped output writable

checks.name: RESOURCE_LIMITS
checks.assertion: CPU, memory, disk, process-count, and wall-time limits declared and enforceable

checks.name: DETERMINISTIC_RUNTIME
checks.assertion: UTF-8, line endings, UTC, locale, sorting, clock, seed, and serialization are pinned

checks.name: OUTPUT_PATH_AND_SEALING
checks.assertion: case-scoped output is available and artifact fingerprints can be sealed

checks.name: PRIVACY_CONTROLS
checks.assertion: synthetic classification, redaction profile, raw-output handling, and stable fingerprints are available

checks.name: EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_READINESS
checks.assertion: future evidence record can reference fixture, authority, runner, environment, output, lineage, and review

checks.name: REVIEW_SEPARATION
checks.assertion: operator and independent reviewer identities are declared and differ
